prerequisites: knowledge of the basic circuit notions

learning_outcomes.text: knowledge of the hardware implementation of Boolean algebra, from an analog and digital perspectives;
capability of description and synthesis of finite state synchronous digital systems in direct hardware logic;

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the fundamental concepts of digital electronics
Boolean algebra, synthesis methods and reduction methods
Introduction to basic analog electronics for the implementation of logic gates
Combinatorial digital electronics, from combinatorial to sequential digital electronics
Synchronous and asynchronous systems: representation models of a finite states machine
Logical description of a states machine

assessment_methods.method: Written exam containing two theoretical questions
Synthesis project of a digital system in direct hardware
Brief report on the activities carried out in the laboratory

assessment_rules: The exam type is oral. The grading is based on a final grade. The assessment methods include a written exam with two theoretical questions and a synthesis project of a digital system. Students must also submit a brief report on laboratory activities.
bibliography: P. Spirito, "Elettronica Digitale" III Edizione, Mc Graw-Hill
R.J. Tocci, N.S. Widmer, G. Moss, "Digital Systems, Global Edition" XII Edition, Pearson
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
